title: fix(rest): the public lookup picker searches and sorts by the first display field the caller may query
body:
Part of #21062
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

Position 2 of #21062 only. Position 1 (the public-form submit read-back, in `plugin-security`) is a separate PR on its own branch, so this PR does not close the card.

## What this changes

`GET /forms/:slug/lookup/:field`, the public form's lookup picker, matches the visitor's search and orders its rows by one key. The handler took that key blindly from the first entry of `publicPicker.displayFields`. A field whose masking rule applies to the caller is served to it masked and is not queryable, and the engine refuses a search or an order on it with `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. Since PR #21051 that includes the caller who resolves no permission set. So a picker whose first display field declares a masking rule answered `403` to every caller the rule applies to, on every request.

The key is now the first display field the caller may query on, by the security service's published answer (`ISecurityService.getQueryableFields`, #20935). The handler reads it through the security service it already resolves (`resolveSecurityService`), for the context it already builds. No masking rule is derived in `rest`.

- **No display field queryable:** the route answers the engine's refusal for those fields, in the same envelope (`403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, the flat body `mapDataError` already produces for this route) and with the engine's sentence, before any query runs.
- **No security service:** nothing is masked on such a deployment, and the first display field stays the key, as before.
- **A security service that cannot give the query answer** (the method absent, or it answered `undefined`): the fallback the contract prescribes on `getQueryableFields`. Every display field whose declaration carries a `maskingRule` is passed over, whoever the caller is. A declaration that cannot be read admits no display field.
- The projection is unchanged. Every display field is still returned in each row, and the engine still masks the masked one.

File surface: `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts`, the picker handler's key selection only (the context moved above it, unchanged). Pins beside it, one dogfood pin, and `.changeset/21062-picker-queryable-key.md`.

## Per case, by class (measured on real boots)

`bootStack` with the real security, REST, auth and SQL layers, before at `d9b2e34fac` (the pins commit, the route as on `main`) and after at `2fa3a86e9b`. Three deployments: no guest set registered; a guest set without the capability the rule names; a guest set holding it. The readings stay in the seat's private scratch.

| Picker | Caller class | Before: status, key | After: status, key |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| First display field masked | visitor with no session, no guest set registered (resolves no set) | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` on every request; the masked field | 200; the next queryable display field; masked field served masked |
| First display field masked | visitor, guest set without the capability | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` on every request; the masked field | 200; the next queryable display field; masked field served masked |
| First display field masked | signed-in caller the rule applies to | 403, the same as the visitor | 200, the same as the visitor |
| First display field masked | visitor, guest set holding the capability (rule lifted) | 200; the first display field; served stored | unchanged |
| Masked field not first (the dogfood shape) | every class above | 200; the first display field; masked where the rule applies | unchanged |
| No masked display field (control) | every class above | 200; the first display field | unchanged |
| Only display field masked | the two classes the rule applies to | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, from the engine | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`, from the route before the engine is asked; same refusal text |

The signed-in caller reads the same as the visitor in every row, before and after: the door builds its own context and does not read the session.

**What a search finds (H4).** For a picker whose first display field is masked, every search was refused before. After, a search matches the next queryable display field, so a caller finds rows by that field. A search for the masked field's value finds no row. In every other row of the table the search matches the same field as before, and what a caller finds is unchanged.

## Pins, red then green

- `packages/rest/src/public-form-lookup-picker-queryable-key.test.ts` (new). The real `SecurityPlugin` over a real `ObjectQL` on a real `SqlDriver`, and the real protocol `findData`, so the request the route composes crosses the real ingress and the engine's own field guards. Two masked caller classes, each with: the premise (the security service answers the masked field readable and not queryable, and the engine refuses it); rows sorted on the next queryable display field with the masked field served masked; the search matching that field; no request the engine receives naming the masked field; and a picker with no queryable display field answering the engine's refusal (code, status and text equal to the engine's own for the same fields and context) with the engine never asked. Controls: a picker with no masked display field, and a caller the rule is lifted for. The fallback: a security service without the method, and one answering `undefined`, for a caller the rule applies to and for one it is lifted for. The declared narrowing (patch round 2): the same fallback service, a caller the rule is lifted for, and a picker whose display fields all declare a masking rule, refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` with the engine never asked; its control is the answering service, which serves that caller. The pickers are parsed by the spec's own `FormFieldPublicPickerSchema` first.
- `packages/qa/dogfood/test/public-picker-queryable-key.dogfood.test.ts` (new). A real boot: the visitor with no session and a signed-in caller are served rows sorted, and searched, on the next queryable display field with the masked field served masked; a picker whose only display field is masked answers `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`.
- Red on the pins commit `d9b2e34fac`: unit 12 failed, 6 passed (both masked classes on sorted, searched, never-a-key and the no-queryable refusal, and the four fallback cases; each failure on the defect: a 403 where 200 was expected, the masked field as the order key, the engine asked, the masked order). Dogfood 1 of 1 failed (403 where 200 was expected).
- Green on the fix commit `2fa3a86e9b`: unit 18 of 18; the four sibling picker and public-form suites 69 of 69; `@objectstack/rest` rebuilt and the dogfood pin 1 of 1.

## Ablation

On the fix commit `2fa3a86e9b`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode: the queryable branch of the key expression (the first display field in the security service's answer) is replaced by the first display field, so the key is `displayFields[0]` again on every path. Anchor 1 to 0, replacement 1 to 2, blob `e2f14974` to `d520d9ab`.

- **Prediction**, written down before the run: exactly the 12 unit pins that were red on the pins commit go red and the other 6 stay green; the dogfood pin goes red.
- **Unit pins:** 12 failed, 6 passed. They are the same 12 as the red run, compared by name.
- **Rebuilt** `@objectstack/rest`; `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` passed (the marker is in none of the 6 built files; on the pristine build the same marker was in 2).
- **Dogfood pin:** 1 of 1 failed, on a 403 where 200 was expected.
- **Restore:** `git checkout HEAD --` on the absolute path, by the tool and again by the script's own `EXIT INT TERM` trap. Proven byte-identical: the blob equals HEAD's (`e2f14974`), `git diff HEAD` is empty and the status is clean. Rebuilt; the marker is back in 2 built files; unit pins 18 of 18 and the dogfood pin 1 of 1.
- **A first attempt was a no-op and is not counted.** Its replacement text already sat inside its anchor, so the replacement count did not rise and `ablation-replace` refused to run anything. The anchor was narrowed and the ablation repeated; the readings above are the second attempt's.

## Local verification

At the merged head `cdeed45868`. `origin/main` was merged twice (no rebase) before opening this PR, and both merges were clean. They brought three changes to `rest-server.ts`, all outside this handler: one import line (#21084), the published-snapshot doors (#21002) and the datasource metadata reads (#21119). The changed packages' closure was rebuilt first.

- Picker and public-form suites with the new pins: 5 files, 87 of 87. Dogfood, this pin and the #20995 zero-set pin: 2 files, 3 of 3.
- `@objectstack/rest` tests (`--project local`): 250 files, 4744 passed, 248 skipped. `@objectstack/rest` typecheck passed, the test layer included (`check:test-typecheck` OK, 0 errors).
- `@objectstack/dogfood` typecheck passed. Its tsconfig includes `test/**/*`, so the new pin is compiled.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: 66 commands, plus the three roster families it marks under a directory this diff touches (`check-changeset-fixed`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`) and `check-partof-closing-keyword` fed this body. All 77 ran in one locked sequential script and every one exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 derived, 66 run, 0 not measured.
- `eslint --no-inline-config --format json` on the 3 touched TypeScript files: 3 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The population is `eslint.config.mjs`'s TypeScript and JavaScript glob, and all 3 files are in it. The config enables no type-aware linting, so this diff cannot move the verdict on any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.

## Acceptance notes

- **Clause-②: `yes (narrowing)`, per the contract review** (`5929549767`, which ruled the earlier `no` wrong). Widening: a picker whose first display field is masked for its caller was refused and is now served. Narrowing: for a security service that lacks `getQueryableFields`, a caller the masking rule is lifted for, and a picker whose display fields all declare a masking rule, the request was served and is now refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, by the fallback the service contract prescribes. The only security service in the tree (`plugin-security`) implements the method, so no in-tree composition reaches the narrowing; the contract names that composition as valid, so it is declared. Patch round 2 carries the `minor` changeset and its pin.
- **The spec describe on `FormFieldPublicPickerSchema.displayFields`** says the visitor's search matches the first entry. For a caller whose masking rule applies to the first entry it now matches the first entry that caller may query; before this PR that search was refused. `packages/spec/src/**` is outside this PR's claimed surface, so the describe is reported to the seat for the spec owner and is not edited here.
- **A declared `publicPicker.filter` row that names a masked field** is still refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` for every caller the rule applies to. It is the author's filter, not the route's key, so this PR leaves it alone, and it was measured unchanged. Reported to the seat, by class.
- **The refusal text is the engine's predicate-guard sentence, carried into the route** so that a caller reads the same words whichever side refuses. The unit pin asserts it equal to the engine's live refusal for the same fields and context, so the copy cannot drift silently.
- **Not measured:** a security service without the method on a real boot (the tree has none); the published-snapshot door and the form-submit route, which are outside this surface; the Console's picker client, which lives in another repository. CI's whole-root and workflow-valued families (10 and 6), the 5 path-scheduled CI jobs and the 4 type-check lanes the derivation names run on this PR.

## Patch round 1

CI's `Test Core (3/6)` was red on this PR's own change: `@objectstack/rest#test:repo` failed in `packages/rest/src/rest-server-canonical-query-ast.test.ts`. That test's by-name presence pin (section 1, "names them") still asserted the picker's query literal ordered by `displayFields[0]`. The local runs had used `vitest --project local`, which does not run the repo-test project.

- **Reproduced first** at `cdeed45868`, under the verify lock: `test:repo` 1 failed, 178 passed, 1 skipped (5 files). The one failure is that pin.
- **The pin's purpose is kept.** It is a backstop for the census: it proves the server-built literals are still present, in the canonical QueryAST spelling. It now names the picker's literal as it is, `orderBy` on the handler's one key. It also names the line that derives that key from the security service's queryable answer, so no other `key` in the file can satisfy it. `rest-server.ts` is untouched in this round (`d815dd449a`).
- **Full `@objectstack/rest` surface** at the merged head `6dacc4c51b` (`origin/main` merged, no rebase, no conflicts): every project together, 256 files (251 local and 5 repo, which is the whole tracked population), 4925 passed and 249 skipped; `test:repo` on its own, 5 files, 179 passed and 1 skipped; typecheck OK, the test layer included. The dogfood picker and zero-set pins: 3 of 3. Dogfood typecheck OK.
- **Gates:** the 66 derived commands, the three roster families and `check-partof-closing-keyword`, in one locked script; every exit 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 of 66, 0 not measured. eslint on the 4 touched TypeScript files: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- **CI on `6dacc4c51b`:** 32 success, 3 skipped, 0 failed, all six `Test Core` shards included.
- **Tooling note, outside this diff:** the `turbo` version `main` now pins writes an agent-guidance block into `AGENTS.md` when it runs in an agent session. It happened twice here: during the closure build, and from a type-check gate that spawns `turbo`. Both times `AGENTS.md` was restored from `HEAD` with the blob proven equal, and the gates the write could have reached were re-run on the clean tree. `AGENTS.md` is not in this PR. Already filed as #21146, with the fix in flight as PR #21151.

## Patch round 2

The contract review (`5929549767`) ruled the earlier `Clause-②: no` wrong. The value is `yes (narrowing)`, at least `minor`. This round carries its items 2 and 3 and nothing else. `rest-server.ts` is not touched.

- **Changeset** `.changeset/21062-picker-queryable-key.md`: `'@objectstack/rest': minor`; the summary is `fix(rest)!:`; a `**BREAKING**` banner names the narrowing by class (with a security service that lacks `getQueryableFields` or answers no answer, every display field declaring a `maskingRule` is passed over for every caller, so a picker whose display fields all declare one is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` without the engine being asked); the body's declaration line reads `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`; exactly one `adr-0087:` marker, `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, in the shape of #20986's changeset, closing the other four categories on facts. The widening text is kept. The fallback, which round 0 listed under "Unchanged", moved to the banner, and a "What to do after upgrading" paragraph addresses a deployer whose security service predates `getQueryableFields`. `scripts/pm/clause2-line.mjs` reads the line as declared `yes`, arm `narrowing`.
- **Pin on the declared narrowing**, appended to `packages/rest/src/public-form-lookup-picker-queryable-key.test.ts`, with the existing synthetic fixtures. A caller the rule is lifted for is served by the answering service (the control). With the method absent, and with it answering no answer, the same caller is refused `403` with code `PERMISSION_DENIED`, and the engine's call count is unchanged.
- **Ablation:** the fallback stops excluding fields that declare a masking rule, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in wrap mode (anchor 1 to 0, replacement 0 to 1). The prediction was written down before the run: the new pin and the four round-0 fallback pins go red, because they drive the same branch; the other 14 stay green. Observed: 5 failed, 14 passed, those five by name; the new pin failed on a 200 where the 403 was expected. The restore was proven by the tool (blob equal to `HEAD`'s, `git diff HEAD` empty), and the pin file is green again, 19 of 19.
- **Merged** `origin/main` first (no rebase, clean; no incoming change to `rest-server.ts`). Head `207eb98a97`.
- **`@objectstack/rest`:** all vitest projects, 257 files (the whole tracked population, local and repo), 4931 passed and 254 skipped; `test:repo` on its own, 5 files, 179 passed and 1 skipped; typecheck OK, the test layer included. Dogfood picker and zero-set pins 3 of 3; dogfood typecheck OK.
- **Gates:** in one locked script, the changeset families against the new declaration ran first: `check-adr-0087-registration` reads `[BREAKING+bang+clause-②-narrowing]` with `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`; `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-empty-changeset` and `check-changeset-fixed` passed. Then the 66 derived commands, the three roster families, `check-partof-closing-keyword` fed the live body, and eslint on the 4 touched TypeScript files (0 errors, 0 warnings). All 81 commands exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 66 of 66, 0 not measured. Locally `check-changeset-no-major`'s level axis has no PR payload to read and says so; CI's `Check Changeset` reads it, and it passed.
- **`turbo` and `AGENTS.md`:** `turbo` wrote its block into `AGENTS.md` during the closure build and during `check:type-check-debt`. The script restored it from `HEAD` after each command and proved the blob, so every later command ran on the clean tree. `AGENTS.md` is not in this PR.
- **CI on `207eb98a97`:** 35 check runs, 32 success, 3 skipped (path and opt-in filters), 0 failed. Every required context is success, `Check Changeset` and all six `Test Core` shards included.
